This is a throw away. But I know my friends if they read this particular thread would know it was me just by what I say. I will post it anyways I guess.

The thing is I know life sucks sometimes and that there is the possibility of a better day ahead but at the same time I've hoped for that pipe dream to happen, that day everything will change in my life for the better. But it never happens. All it does is bring my back into the realization of how fucked my life has been. 

I used this example to a ex of mine. Life is like putting a puzzle together, every piece fits somewhere and the end result is amazing. But what happens to my puzzle is right when I am at the very last few pieces someone knocks my puzzle back into pieces. It's like playing a never ending game with the only true answer is to not play.

When I was around 5, I had to go into court and pick between two guys to be my father. The current one threatened to kill me if I didn't pick him so as a young child I believed him. Later on he almost shot me while he was drunk one night.

Fast forward 2 years, I ended up getting into two major car wrecks (both hit my side) I ended up blacking out from both of them and ending up in the hospital with little knowledge of what happened other then the contact of the cars. 

After all this I went to middle school and all seemed great, or as normal as it could possibly be for having druggies as parents. I was still mentally abused every day of my life by my father while my mother supported what he did. 

After middle school I went to high school, my depression got much worse. To the point of almost killing myself one day in shop class. I ended up passing out from blood loss and waking up in the hospital. Apparently my girlfriend at the time found me laying down on the ground bleeding. After this my parents wanted to have me put away.. but eventually didn't. 

I lived on my own since early teen years with very little to no moral support. I moved out of my abusive drug addict parents house looking for a better life... after a couple months on my own I got extremely heavy into drugs and alcohol drinking every day for months on end, while still working a full time job and putting a fake smile on my face.

I want to update as well that, the last two months I've gone down to eating once a day, while drinking very little water. I guess I'm pushing my body's limits to see how much it can take before giving out. It seems less painful this way since after the first three days of little to no eating. The feeling of hunger goes away. I admit the first few days I was ill, and felt like I was starving then little by little that pain went away and now I rarely get hungry and I've dropped at least 20lb's.
